_meta.title: Qwen3.5-9B encoder (~9 GB) - type MUST be moss_image. Feeds the edit LoRA (node 5), NOT the encoders directly.
FLUX.2 VAE (also encodes the reference sheet)
4-STEP SPEED LoRA (model only) - REQUIRED at steps:4. Delete this node and reconnect 1 -> 5 for the 20-step quality variant.

EDIT LoRA as a FULL LoraLoader (model AND clip) - NOT LoraLoaderModelOnly. The clip side is what adapts the text encoder that encodes the edit instruction; without it the reference binds weakly. Both encoders (17, 23) must take their CLIP from node 5 output 1.

REF 1 - built-in. ST substitutes "%char_avatar%" with bare base64; PERCENT SIGNS MANDATORY and it must be the whole value. NB in GROUP chats ST picks the last speaker else a RANDOM member - drive slots 2-4 from custom placeholders for deterministic casting.
REF 2 - custom placeholder {find:'ref2'}. Leave unset for a solo scene: node 40 DROPS it. Set replace to '%user_avatar%' or '{{getvar::name_b64}}'.
REF 3 - custom placeholder {find:'ref3'}. Dropped automatically when unset.
REF 4 - custom placeholder {find:'ref4'}. Dropped automatically when unset.

Drops blank/unset slots, tiles the rest into ONE 1024^2 sheet (1 -> full frame, 2 -> side by side, 3-4 -> 2x2). This is what lets one workflow serve solo and group scenes. target_size MUST equal node 10's latent size. Replaces the old per-slot ImageScale.

inputs.string_a: Keep the person in the reference image exactly identical: same face, same hair colour and style, same eye colour, same skin tone, same build. Reference panels read left to right then top to bottom; ignore any blank panel.

_meta.title: POSITIVE edit instruction + scene. Keep string_a SHORT and in natural language (MOSS edit is an instruction model, not booru). string_b must stay exactly "%prompt%" - ST only substitutes a standalone quoted value.

Reference-conditioned POSITIVE. edit_format=ai-toolkit (matches the proven moss-ref-edit-*.json graphs; the LoRA's training layout). CLIP comes from node 5 output 1 (LoRA-adapted). images.* is a v3 Autogrow input - API format needs the FLAT DOTTED KEY.

inputs.string_a: different face, different person, changed identity, deformed face, blurry face, extra people, changed hair colour

_meta.title: NEGATIVE = identity protection + ST's negative. At cfg 3.0 the negative is LIVE (it is only inert at cfg 1.0), so this matters.
Reference-conditioned NEGATIVE with the SAME sheet - the node's own description says 'use it for the negative prompt too'. Replaces the old plain CLIPTextEncode negative.
Latent 1024x1024 (MOSS-Image trained square). MUST match node 40's target_size.

steps 4 / cfg 3.0 / euler / sgm_uniform - the settings verified good both in ComfyUI /history and in the proven moss-ref-edit-4step.json graph. For the 20-step quality variant: delete node 4, reconnect 1 -> 5, set steps 20.
